description: Create a 3-layer network with custom node colors (yellow nodes, red outline) to demonstrate FeedForwardLayer color customization.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_ml.neural_network import NeuralNetwork, FeedForwardLayer

class FFNCustomColors(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        nn = NeuralNetwork([
            FeedForwardLayer(3, node_color=YELLOW, node_outline_color=RED),
            FeedForwardLayer(5, node_color=YELLOW, node_outline_color=RED),
            FeedForwardLayer(2, node_color=YELLOW, node_outline_color=RED),
        ])
        nn.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.add(nn)
        self.wait(0.5)
